description: List the WhatsApp message templates (Meta-approved message formats) of this workspace: name, exact language code, category (MARKETING / UTILITY / AUTHENTICATION), Meta review status and the rejection reason when Meta gave one, body text, header type, and the placeholders each template expects (numbered {{1}} or named {{customer_name}}). Each row says whether send_template can send it (only APPROVED, non-carousel templates). Use it before send_template to pick a template and pass its exact name, language and parameters, or to answer "which templates were rejected and why?". Filters: status, category, language, search (name, template id or language); 50 per page. Read-only: it does not create, edit, submit or sync templates with Meta — that is done in the LetsBot panel. Templates exist only on the official WhatsApp Cloud API connection.

category.description: Only templates of this Meta category.

page.description: Page number (50 templates per page). Default 1.

search.description: Text to find in the template name, Meta template id or language code.

status.description: Only templates with this Meta status. APPROVED templates are the only ones that can be sent.

name: list_whatsapp_templates
